name: F900
summary: Large-build industrial FDM for production parts, tooling and big prototypes.

page.description: Stratasys F900 3D printer from IME Additive Manufacturing, Malaysia: specifications, applications and pricing.
page.headline: The standard for
page.lead: The FDM workhorse: a 914 × 610 × 914 mm build, Stratasys’ widest choice of FDM materials, including ULTEM, PEKK and PEEK, and the repeatability that regulated production depends on.
page.footnote: * or ±0.0015 mm/mm, whichever is greater. Source: stratasys.com F900 page, read 10 Nov 2026.
page.features_heading: Built for big parts and regulated production.

features.title: Two build zones
features.text: Small or large build sheets on the same platen.

features.title: Soluble support
features.text: Complex internal geometry that machining can’t make.

features.title: Fortus FDC (optional)
features.text: Material delivery and drying cabinet for longer unattended builds.

features.title: Shop-floor data
features.text: MTConnect, Insight and Control Center job management.

features.title: ProtectAM (optional)
features.text: Secure operating system for U.S. DoD STIG requirements.

benefits.title: Production-ready
benefits.text: Large single-piece parts or multi-part batches.

specs.label: Accuracy
specs.value: ±0.089 mm or ±0.0015 mm/mm, whichever is greater; Z adds slice-height tolerance (95 % dimensional yield)

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: Includes ULTEM 9085 and ULTEM 1010 resin, Antero 800NA and 840CN03 (PEKK), VICTREX AM 200 PEEK, FDM Nylon 12CF, FDM PA6/66-GF30-FR and ASA in 12 colours. Full list on the spec sheet.

specs.label: Material delivery
specs.value: 2 model + 2 support canisters, 1,508 cm³ each; with Fortus FDC, 2 model canisters of 4,097 cm³

specs.label: Software
specs.value: GrabCAD Print, GrabCAD Print Pro, Insight, Control Center; ProtectAM optional

specs.label: Compliance
specs.value: CE, cTUVus, RCM, EAC, FCC Part B

page.applications_heading: Large prototypes, tooling and certified production parts.
page.applications_text: Used in aerospace, rail, automotive and defence, where part size, material performance and traceability matter.

applications.title: Rapid prototyping
applications.text: Full-size functional prototypes for fast design iteration.

applications.title: Manufacturing tooling
applications.text: Lighter jigs, fixtures and manufacturing aids in thermoplastics.
